data.Title: The Mummy
data.Writer: Stephen Sommers, Lloyd Fonvielle, Kevin Jarre
data.Actors: Brendan Fraser, Rachel Weisz, John Hannah
data.Plot: At an archaeological dig in the ancient city of Hamunaptra, an American serving in the French Foreign Legion accidentally awakens a mummy who begins to wreak havoc as he searches for the reincarnation of his long-lost love.
data.Language: English, Egyptian (Ancient), Arabic, Chinese, Hebrew, Hungarian
data.Awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 5 wins & 24 nominations total
